DEN SYSTEM

New Den System Guide: Defend Your Home in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D

📅 November 20, 2026 • ⏱ 6 min read • 🏢 Gameyard Studio

Every wild beast needs a sacred sanctuary to rest, recuperate, and raise offspring away from the harsh elements. The all-new Den System in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D introduces tactical home base mechanics to the open world. Grab the latest update on the Google Play Store and learn how to claim, upgrade, and defend your territory.

How to Discover and Claim a Den

As you explore the three unique wilderness worlds in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D, keep your eyes open for secluded rock caves, hollowed ancient trees, and sheltered river alcoves. These landmark locations serve as prospective den foundations:

  • Clear Existing Occupants: Some prime den locations are occupied by rival predators or territorial bears. Defeat the occupants to claim the site.
  • Scent-Mark Territory: Mark the perimeter of the cave entrance to establish your pack's scent barrier, warning lower-tier carnivores to stay away.
  • Rest & Health Recovery: Sleeping inside your den provides accelerated health and energy regeneration rates compared to resting in open fields.

Defending Against Den Invasions

A thriving den attracts attention. In Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D, hostile predator patrols—including rogue wolves, hyena scavengers, and opportunistic big cats—will periodically stage attacks against your sanctuary, particularly when your mate is nursing young cubs.

Proven Den Defense Strategies:

  • Funnel Enemies at the Chokepoint: Do not let invading packs flank your den interior. Stand firm at the narrow entrance mouth, forcing enemies to engage one-by-one.
  • Coordinate with Your Mate: Use command pings to have your mate guard the rear while you unleash your strongest combat abilities at the front lines.
  • Deploy Special Powers: Activate your Shield and Fire Attack powers to break through hostile siege groups quickly.

Claim Your Fortress in the Wild

Establish your den, protect your cubs, and build your kingdom in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D. Play free today on Android!
